edges.reason: Constructor parameter _rewardStartTime is stored in rewardStartTime.
Constructor parameter _key is stored in the key state variable.
Constructor parameter _withdrawer is stored in the withdrawer state variable.
msg.sender is assigned to owner in the constructor, granting administrative privileges.
onlyWithdrawer modifier gates collectToken on msg.sender.
withdrawer state variable is compared against msg.sender to authorise collectToken.
withdrawer comparison authorises transferTokens via onlyWithdrawer.
onlyOwner modifier checks owner before setWithdrawer executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks owner before setOwner executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks owner before pauseCollectToken executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks owner before resumeCollectToken executes.
setWithdrawer parameter overwrites the privileged withdrawer address.
setOwner parameter overwrites the owner address.
setWithdrawer writes the withdrawer state variable.
setOwner writes the owner state variable.
pauseCollectToken sets paused to true, blocking collection.
resumeCollectToken sets paused to false.
notPaused modifier requires the paused flag to be false before collectToken runs.
block.timestamp (now) is returned by time(), making execution timestamp dependent.
Timestamp comparison with rewardStartTime drives yearFor computation.
time() result feeds the reward accrual logic of collectToken.
time() supplies the timestamp used by yearFor.
Block timestamp influences the arithmetic reward amounts computed in collectToken.
collectToken performs add/mul/div/sub reward math sensitive to overflow or rounding.
collectToken makes the external key.transfer call, enabling potential re-entry into pool logic.
Computed canExtract amount is the value passed to _key.transfer.
withdrawer address is the recipient of the external key transfer.
yearFor timestamp parameter is used in the year arithmetic.
transferTokens performs an external ERC20 transfer that could re-enter the pool.
dst parameter is the recipient of the recovered token transfer.
wad parameter is the amount of the recovered token transfer.
_token parameter determines which external ERC20 contract is called.
key state variable is the token contract on which transfer is invoked.
collectedTokens participates in the reward arithmetic.
totalRewardThisYear participates in the reward arithmetic.
yearlyRewardPercentage is multiplied into the reward arithmetic.
_time local is populated from the time() (block.timestamp) call.
_time local is used in the modular and subtraction reward math.
balance local participates in the total and cap arithmetic.
total local participates in the reward computation.
remainingTokens local is decayed through yearly arithmetic.
yearCount loop counter drives the reward arithmetic iterations.
canExtractThisYear local is produced by and consumed in the reward arithmetic.
local_key memory copy is used to query the pool token balance.
key storage variable is copied into the local_key memory pointer.
mint is protected by the auth modifier on msg.sender.
burn is protected by the auth modifier on msg.sender.
isAuthorized passes msg.sender as src to the external authority.canCall check.
collectToken invokes key.transfer, which dispatches into DSToken.transfer.
_token parameter is compared against the key address to forbid recovering the reward token.
msg.sender is the debited account in DSToken.transfer balance checks.

Constructor parameter _key only feeds the KeyRewardPool constructor state assignment.

yearFor timestamp parameter is local to the yearFor function computation.
_withdrawer_ parameter is consumed by setWithdrawer when writing withdrawer.
_owner parameter is consumed by setOwner when writing owner.
dst parameter is consumed by transferTokens for the recovery transfer.
wad parameter is consumed by transferTokens for the recovery transfer amount.
_token parameter is consumed by transferTokens to select the ERC20 called.
_time local variable is a temporary inside collectToken's timestamp-dependent logic.
local_key memory copy is a temporary optimisation inside collectToken.
balance local variable is a temporary inside collectToken.
total local variable is a temporary inside collectToken.
remainingTokens local variable is a temporary inside collectToken.
yearCount local variable is a loop temporary inside collectToken.
canExtract local variable is the amount handed to the external key transfer unsafe operation.
canExtractThisYear local variable is a temporary computed inside collectToken.
